text: {"status":"answered","answer":"Under the Overdraft Policy v3.0 (effective 1 January 2026), Harbor charges $29 per item for items paid through Courtesy Pay, up to a maximum of three (3) items per business day \ncap of $87 a day. No overdraft fee is charged if your account is overdrawn by $25.00 or less at the end of the business day, and no fee applies to items Harbor returns unpaid (a returned item/NSF fee of $27.00 per item applies instead, per the Schedule of Fees and Charges 2026).
